findings.problem: An independent raw base read and loader-wide unloaded-category cache could allow a class/valuetype encoding to disagree with the canonical graph later completed for that definition.
findings.resolution: Signature traversal records bounded per-root obligations on canonical definitions. Loaded kind or the same immutable direct-binding template used by closure/completion supplies category, recognized through the defining loader's exact intrinsic identity. No speculative unloaded category is shared across roots.

findings.problem: Checking only the completed top-level result would miss nominal encodings inside a born-loaded wrapper whose element definition remains unloaded.
findings.resolution: Every encoded nominal occurrence contributes an obligation. Known obligations are validated after closure proof and before loaded return/publication. The root drains unresolved definitions and rejects any still-unresolved category before final return or weak admission.

findings.problem: Starting generic ownership only after a nominal TypeRef handle arrived would leave its initial external wait outside the new category operation's cancellation/lifetime setup.
findings.resolution: The nominal token resolver enables the same generic operation before calling the loader, in addition to recording its category after resolution. Plain nongeneric TypeSpecs enter qualification before nominal publication.

findings.problem: The arity-only warm-instantiation cost sentence did not account for intentionally withheld or unavailable optional proof admission.
findings.resolution: Documentation now limits that cost statement to a tuple with an admitted immutable proof and explicitly describes reproof of loaded tuples with unloaded dependencies or no optional admission.

independentBoundaryReview: Duplicate encodings of an unloaded canonical definition share a Map entry; contradictory encodings reject before speculative base resolution. A satisfied entry may be removed safely because a later occurrence is checked against the same immutable record or authoritative loaded kind.

The pending-definition Map iterator remains live across awaited closure work. Newly appended obligations are visited; removed satisfied entries are skipped. Every addition/validation/proof visit consumes the existing bounded root allowance.
An unknown outer or reentrant obligation is left pending during nested work. validateCategories(true) rejects any unknown obligation at the final root boundary.

Every satisfaction path polls the operation before reading category facts. After awaited proof/drain work the scalar binding-conflict, cancellation and lifetime gates remain active. The existing publication boundary still checks the publisher's own expected direct record before loaded mutation.

No parser-time category-base traversal remains, avoiding recursive reads of legal self-referential generic signature templates. Exact owner TypeDesc and intrinsic identities remain distinct across contexts.
Category records belong only to the root and clear in dispose. They add no loader-wide strong owner registry, category result cache or pending self-promise.
Existing TypeRef/TypeSpec active-resolution guards, the frozen original Node fixture, native observer/toolchain sources and all retained historical results are unchanged.

authoredTestCases.checks: One selected foreign ValueType handle remains an ordinary Class base under the owner-intrinsic identity rule; completion and encoding agree; later incompatible encoding rejects.

The first wrapper uses its exact proof category while the element definition remains unloaded; a later canonical value-type completion makes class encoding reject; corrected encoding preserves the existing wrapper identity.
A failed value encoding does not cache an unloaded classification; a later class encoding rebinds and succeeds to the same canonical shape.
Value-classified definitions reject before requested nominal publication, including plain nongeneric TypeSpecs.
The same canonical definition encoded both ways rejects without a speculative base callback.
A pending raw read adopts another root's completed Class authority and rejects an incompatible value encoding.
The pending consumer cancels promptly; late rejection stays observed; no requested type is published and retry succeeds.
The generic independent wait begins before the external handle arrives; late completion remains observed and retry resolves the canonical intrinsic.
